title: The four issues our experts are watching ahead of this week’s Trump-Xi summit
gist: Four Atlantic Council GeoEconomics experts preview the Sept 24 Trump-Xi summit amid a trade truce capping new US tariffs at a ~30% effective rate: AI cooperation is constrained by the tech race and distillation concerns; Washington lacks a coherent China strategy; expect only a narrow trade deal (soybeans, critical minerals); and China's weak domestic economy (Rhodium: ~2% cumulative 2021-25 growth) makes Xi need US export access.

insights.claim: The Trump-Xi summit takes place under a trade truce with an apparent understanding that new US tariffs on China will not exceed an effective rate of 30 percent.
insights.speaker: jyin
insights.so_what: Implied tariff ceiling bounds downside for China-exposed trade flows.
insights.quote: an apparent understanding that any new US tariffs will not exceed an effective rate of 30 percent
